# Hello! I'm Chin Wei.

[I'm curious about what happens to our cognition when we start treating "artificial" agents like social partners.]{.hero-lede}

PhD researcher in psychology at the University of Hull, funded by the White Rose Doctoral Training Partnership (WRDTP).

Part cognitive experimentalist, part data nerd, part builder.
